t: This is the site of Dandie Fashions, a London fashion boutique founded in 1966. It began with a chance meeting at the Speakeasy Club between Freddie Hornik and Alan Holston. They teamed up with the Australian John Crittle, the Guinness heir Tara Browne and Neil Winterbotham to launch the shop. Jimi Hendrix is named as having commissioned it. He was the American guitarist and singer-songwriter often called one of the greatest and most influential guitarists of all time, so his link gives the boutique its place in music history.
